gap: The rail and the list-page frame are genuinely Wave-grade, but the shell is only half-converted: the dashboard - the app's front door - renders inside the Wave shell with NO page title element at all (content h1/h2 count = 0, vs the bar's large bold 'Transactions') and no content frame, its widgets floating on the ground while list pages sit in a rounded white container, and its palette is still BHD teal #009bc1 plus orange and red against the rail's Wave blue #2b57d8. On mobile the shell is worse: header 60px + breadcrumb to y=100 + a 59px dead band + a four-row control stack ending at y=430 means 52% of an 844px viewport is chrome before the first data row, and that stack includes a segmented view toggle whose UNSELECTED half carries the grey fill and two full-width 44px pills holding one unlabelled icon each. BHD is untouched (verified) and the rail EASES, it does not jump - so neither of those is the gap.
